prerequisites: Course succeeds to compulsory courses of previous semester

learning_outcomes.text: Characterize principles and laws of the chosen problems of the classical physics.
Describe, clarify and interpret the respective natural phenomena.
Measure selected physical quantities, tabulate results and compute dependent quantities.
Compare computed results with the tabled ones or results obtained from another experiments.

syllabus_topics: Laboratory tasks: Young modulus: rod deflection
